# This is a BASELINE, not a permission slip. Every name here is a real
# disagreement with a real measurement, and each one has its reasoning
# recorded. CI goes red if a name appears that is not here, AND if a name
# here starts passing without being removed.
#
# Ruled 2026-09-22 with the V/Q category-error fix (4579c4e). That commit
# corrected gas volume being allocated by the V/Q ratio -- a ratio of two
# flows cannot allocate a volume -- which fixed the model's two largest
# disagreements with the only human measurement of arterial oxygen under
# complete obstruction and broke these in exchange. The trade is the
# substance of that commit and is argued in its message.

Stock obstructed, 1-5 min slope
ICSM jet, PaO2 at cricothyroidotomy
ICSM jet, PaCO2 at cricothyroidotomy

# helps twice over -- a larger oxygen store AND better denitrogenation -- so
# the modelled gain overshoots the positioning trials. Whether a real lung
# gives tilt both routes is an open question and the four trials cannot
# separate them. Recorded, not compensated.
